description: The auxiliary-name occurrence test agrees with membership in the free-name support of the corresponding shared formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.occursAux_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) {n : ℕ} (a : L.BoundedFormula ℕ n)
  (j : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.occursAux j
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.namedCode S a) =
      true ↔
    j ∈ a.freeVarFinset
